Tender Notice - 14
Wednesday, 15 November 2017
5156 Hits
The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items. The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of “The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by
27/11/2017
up to 3.00 PM. The Technical Bids will be open on the next day i.e. 28/11/2017 at 3.00 pm in the Committee Room, Dean Office. The tender fees of Rs. 1,000/- (nonrefundable) is to be paid by enclosing D.D. favoring ‘Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram’ payable at Sevagram / Wardha.
Tender forms will be available in the office of the Dean (Central Purchase Section) on working days between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm. Tender forms also can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Dean reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
A) Medicine Department: (2nd Call)
1) Non-Invasive portable Ventilator with NIV masks,
2) High Flow Oxygen Therapy System 3 + 1
3) Mobile Surgical LED Spot Light,
4) Hemodialysis Machine with facility of SLED,
5) High Flow Air Oxygen Mixer 1 + 1
Tender Document
B) Community Medicine Department (3rd Call):
1) Four Wheeler Vehicle (Mahindra Bolero ZLX BSIV)
Tender Document
C) MCH, Melghat Project (3rd Call):
1) Four Wheeler Vehicle (Tata Sumo Gold CX PS BS4) against buyback of old Tata Grande
2) Four Wheeler Vehicle (Maruti Suzuki OMNI)
Tender Document
D) Orthopaedics Department (3 rd Call):
1) Kyphoplaty kit (Disposable)
Tender Document
E) HIS Department:
1) 10 KVA Online UPS (2nd Call),
2) Storage of High Capacity,
3) Number Plate Identification Cameras,
4) Night Vision Cameras,
5) Outdoor Shied
Tender Document
F) Microbiology Department:
1) ELISA Microplate Reader,
2) ELISA Microplate Washer,
3) Cold Room
Tender Document
G) Obstetrics and Gynaecology Department:
1) Latest highest quality HD Endo Camera,
2) Cold LED Light source,
3) Fibre Optical Cable,
4) HD Hysterescopy Set,
5) French Semi Rigid Hand instruments Items,
6) High Definition Monitor
Tender Document
